# Lumen standard NDA playbook

The firm's positions for non-disclosure agreements. Review from our client's side. Each rule has a position, a fallback and the severity when the document misses both.

## Rule NDA-01: Confidentiality term
Position: Confidentiality obligations last no more than 3 years from disclosure.
Fallback: Up to 5 years for trade secrets only, if named.
Severity if missed: high

## Rule NDA-02: Residuals
Position: The agreement contains a residuals clause that lets personnel use general knowledge retained in unaided memory.
Fallback: A residuals clause limited to non-technical information.
Severity if missed: medium

## Rule NDA-03: Mutuality
Position: Obligations are mutual when both parties disclose.
Fallback: One-way, when only the counterparty discloses.
Severity if missed: medium

## Rule NDA-04: Governing law
Position: Governing law is one of: England and Wales, New York, Delaware.
Fallback: Any other common-law jurisdiction approved by a partner.
Severity if missed: high

## Rule NDA-05: Non-solicitation
Position: No non-solicitation clause, or one that lasts no more than 12 months and allows general advertisements.
Fallback: Up to 12 months without the advertisement carve-out.
Severity if missed: medium

## Rule NDA-06: Return or destruction
Position: The recipient returns or destroys information on request and may keep copies required by law.
Fallback: Destruction only, with certification.
Severity if missed: low

## Rule NDA-07: Standard exclusions
Position: Confidential information excludes public, already known, third-party and independently developed information.
Fallback: At least public and already known information.
Severity if missed: high

## Rule NDA-08: Compelled disclosure
Position: Disclosure required by law is permitted after notice where lawful.
Fallback: Permitted without notice.
Severity if missed: medium

## Rule NDA-09: No licence
Position: The agreement grants no licence to the information.
Fallback: Silent.
Severity if missed: low

## Rule NDA-10: Assignment
Position: No assignment without consent, except to affiliates.
Fallback: No assignment without consent.
Severity if missed: low

## Rule NDA-11: Remedies
Position: Injunctive relief may be sought; no liquidated damages.
Fallback: Silent on remedies.
Severity if missed: low

## Rule NDA-12: Termination
Position: Either party may end the agreement on notice; obligations survive for the term in rule NDA-01.
Fallback: A fixed term of up to 2 years.
Severity if missed: low
